title: 第一章 外道身外身第二章 大浮屠录
content_zh:
王庆膝盖顶着一成年男子的背撇断脊柱后，将上下身折叠在一起，用一块粗布裹住，大手按住首尾两端，拧干衣服似的双手反复转动了上百圈。
血水从布料中榨出来流到下方的玻璃缸里，没有太多浪费，池子中一片殷红，血柱浇灌下带起一圈圈的沫子漂浮着，味道有些腥甜。
直至拧成了一根结实到完全绷紧的麻绳后，王庆才松手，将手上的红色麻绳扔置在垃圾桶内，紧绷得能立起来。
桶里有五十来根这样的红色麻绳。
他摘下防喷溅的头罩和橡胶手套，揉了揉睡眼惺忪的眼睛，略有疲惫。
地下室内锈蚀的排气扇有气无力转动着，半墙瓷砖上尽是溅射状的暗褐色斑块，覆着虫子尸体的白色灯管把王庆高挑的身影拖得更长。
“现在是几点了。”
王庆问向负责掏空脏器的手下，今天的工作差不多到此结束了。
“十二点半。”
戴着防毒面罩的人回答道。
“都中午了吗，我只向学校请了半天假，得回去上课。把这缸气血精炼提纯后，明天晚上在交接点拿给制药公司的掮客，价钱我已经谈好了，七百五十万。”
王庆解开皮制的屠夫围裙，露出屌丝套装，一水儿黑的运动服。
因是不法生意，同时承担制作和运输的风险，所以利润比可观。
下午像是飞剑课什么来着，晚自习还要到学校的灵脉刷卡吐纳，普通静室的费用是一小时三百元。
“庆哥，学就不用上了，你的本事保送没问题，不去学校也没事，活儿完了哥几个去高跟鞋店乐乐。”
面罩男通过这小半个月的相处，猜测此人并不是学生那么简单。
表面上看只有炼气三层的修为，但实际上用什么方式隐藏了。
筑基境界的强者都是一个照面轰杀至渣，简直法力无边。
在穷文富武的【方舱】内，修真是要花很多钱的。
面罩男本是一个催债团伙的打手，王庆背了委托方很多的账，筑基期的老大带着面罩男去催债，结果老大被王庆给剁了。

这一行本就没有忠义可言，谁能带着多挣元子，谁是牢大。
在这资本为王的世界，王庆必须组建利益集团，顺势着收编了这个催债团伙，成为头目，除了催债外，当下也经营着其它业务，比如说向制药公司的掮客提供医药用品的原材料。
面罩男深谙王庆不是池中之物，肯定是要上大学与天下英豪角逐的，以他的本事，高校里没有可学的，念勾吧书啊。
“现在制度变了，非精英人才子女，必须要全勤。”
为了保留学籍参加高考，王庆不得不回去上课。
前世境界为渡劫极境，离仙道尽头只有半步之遥，至尊修为，魔道巨擘，开创盖世帝术，【外道身外身】。
一个月前。
自己仙劫来临，又遭诸路至尊围攻，已是绝境，为东山再起，只能极尽演绎帝术。
盖世帝术，外道身外身，所有修习过自己所创任意法门的人，都会被自己种下心魔，成为自己的一部分，也是本尊的分身或是夺舍对象。
这个名为王庆的学生，曾经通过一个奇妙的网站链接，下载了自己法门的一部分，并进行修习，成了自己的分身之一。
用这个世界的话来说叫做“穿越”，王庆get到了这个词汇。
刚来这里的时候王庆也懵得很，后现代建筑群，霓虹灯箱，悬浮飞车，互联网，灵能义体，仙道战甲。
现在他已经差不多适应了。
可还有一些问题悬而未决，原以为会穿越到自己熟悉的人身上，再不济也是有自己传承的魔门弟子。
但事实并非如此，还来到了完全陌生的世界，叫做方舱。
方舱是一个完全封闭的超级建筑，共有八十一层，每一层都是无比辽阔的天地，仍然是以修为说话仙道为尊的世界。
是诸天万界毁灭后，唯一存在的最后乐土。
至少在方舱内的历史书上是这样说的。
王庆认为一个月前的战斗没激烈到那种地步，并且时间也对不上。
要么方舱高层在说谎，要么是自己已经来到了诸天万界被毁灭的无数年以后。

目前看来前者的可能性更大。
由于外道身外身已经无限接近于仙法，可横渡岁月长河，虽是王庆本人所创，但并未完善，是不可控且有强大随机性的。
content_en:
After Wang Qing put his knee on the back of an adult man and broke his spine, he folded his upper and lower body together and wrapped them in a piece of coarse cloth. He held down both ends of the body with his big hands and twisted his hands like dry clothes hundreds of times.
The blood was squeezed out of the cloth and flowed into the glass tank below without much waste. The pool was a bright red, and the blood column brought up circles of foam floating in it. The smell was a bit fishy and sweet.
It wasn't until it was twisted into a hemp rope that was strong enough to be completely taut that Wang Qing let go and threw the red hemp rope in his hand into the trash can. It was so tight that it could stand upright.
There are about fifty red hemp ropes like this in the bucket.
He took off his splash-proof hood and rubber gloves and rubbed his sleepy eyes, feeling a little tired.
The rusty exhaust fan in the basement was spinning feebly, and the tiles on half the wall were covered with spattered dark brown patches. The white light tubes covered with insect corpses stretched Wang Qing's tall figure longer.
"What time is it now?"
Wang Qing asked the men responsible for emptying the organs that today's work was almost over.
"Twelve thirty."
The man in the gas mask replied.
"It's already noon. I only asked for a half-day leave from school and have to go back to class. After refining and purifying this vat of blood, I will take it to the pharmaceutical company's broker at the handover point tomorrow night. I have already negotiated a price of 7.5 million."
Wang Qing took off his leather butcher's apron, revealing a silk suit and black sportswear.
Because it is an illegal business, it also bears the risks of production and transportation, so the profit is considerable.
In the afternoon, there was a flying sword class or something, and in the evening for self-study, I had to go to the school's spiritual pulse card to swipe my card and breathe. The cost of an ordinary quiet room is 300 yuan an hour.
"Brother Qing, you don't need to go to school. Your skills are no problem. It's okay if you don't go to school. When the work is done, let's go to the high-heeled store Lele."
After getting along with him for half a month, the masked man guessed that this person was not just a student.
On the surface, he only has the cultivation level of the third level of Qi Refining, but in fact, he hides it in some way.
The strong men in the foundation-building realm were all beaten to pieces with one blow, and their power was simply boundless.
In the "Fangcang" where the poor are rich in culture and the rich in martial arts, cultivating the truth will cost a lot of money.
The masked man was originally a thug of a debt collection gang. Wang Qing took on a lot of debts from the client. The boss in the foundation period took the masked man to collect debts, but the boss was chopped off by Wang Qing.
There is no loyalty in this industry. Whoever can earn more money will be the boss.
In this world where capital is king, Wang Qing had to form an interest group and took advantage of the trend to incorporate this debt collection gang and became the leader. In addition to debt collection, he was also running other businesses, such as providing raw materials for medical supplies to pharmaceutical company brokers.
The masked man knew that Wang Qing was not a creature of the pond. He would definitely go to college to compete with the world's heroes. With his ability, there was nothing he could learn in college, so he went to study in Gouba.
"Now the system has changed. Children of non-elite talents must attend full time."
In order to retain his academic status and take the college entrance examination, Wang Qing had to go back to class.
In the previous life, he was in the extreme realm of transcending tribulations, only half a step away from the end of the immortal path. He was a supreme cultivator, a giant in the demonic path, and created the unparalleled imperial technique, [outer body outside the body].
a month ago.
The immortal calamity has come and he is besieged by all the supreme beings. He is in a desperate situation. In order to make a comeback, he can only perform the best of his imperial skills.
The unparalleled imperial art, outside the body of outsiders, all those who have practiced any method created by themselves will be planted with inner demons by themselves, becoming a part of themselves, and they are also the clone or object of the body.
This student named Wang Qing once downloaded part of his own method through a wonderful website link, practiced it, and became one of his clones.
In the language of this world, it is called "traveling", and Wang Qing got this word.
When he first came here, Wang Qing was also very confused about postmodern buildings, neon light boxes, suspended speeding cars, the Internet, psychic prosthetics, and immortal battles.First.
He's almost adapted to it now.
But there are still some unresolved issues. I originally thought that I would travel back to someone I know well, or at the worst, it would be a disciple of the Demon Sect with my own inheritance.
But that was not the case, and he came to a completely unfamiliar world called Fangcang.
The square cabin is a completely enclosed super building with a total of eighty-one floors. Each floor is an extremely vast world. It is still a world where cultivation is respected and immortality is respected.
It is the only last paradise that exists after the destruction of all heavens and worlds.
At least that's what the history books in the cabin say.
Wang Qing believed that the battle a month ago was not that intense, and the time was not right.
Either the upper management of the cabin was lying, or he had arrived countless years after the destruction of all heavens and worlds.
At present, the former seems more likely.
Since the outer body of the heretic is infinitely close to the immortal method, it can cross the long river of time. Although it was created by Wang Qing himself, it is not perfect, and it is uncontrollable and has strong randomness.
